notes.title: UPDATE 0.5
notes.content:
Hello Turret Girl players!

We hope you're enjoying the game. Today we're releasing a small update that adds some new features and fixes some bugs.

The first addition is automatic saving. Now, if you exit the game during a session, when you return, the game will pick up where you left off. This should make the experience more convenient for you.

We also fixed a bug that caused the screen to freeze if the player ran out of time in the puzzle. Now, instead, a game over screen will appear and offer the option to restart the puzzle.

Finally, we added a reset button that allows the player to erase the save and start from scratch. This can be useful for those who want to experience the game again from the beginning.

We'd like to thank our community for their feedback and suggestions. In particular, we'd like to thank Hanako for their comment that helped us identify and fix these bugs. The community's contribution is key to the success of our game, so thank you all very much.

We hope you continue to enjoy Turret Girl and keep an eye out for more updates in the future.

Until next time!
